title: The Land of Do As You Please
author: Enid Blyton
description: Join Joe, Beth, Franny, and Rick on a magical nighttime adventure to the Faraway Tree.

sets.title: A Message and the Nighttime Journey
sets.passage:
One evening, Joe, Beth, Franny, and Rick received a note from their magical friends, Silky and Moonface. The note invited them to visit a wonderful realm at the top of the Faraway Tree called the Land of Do As You Please. Joe was hesitant at first, fearing they might run into trouble, but Beth and the others persuaded him to go.

At half-past eleven, the children crept downstairs into the dark garden and headed toward the Enchanted Wood. With lanterns illuminating the path, they reached the colossal Faraway Tree and climbed up using a hanging rope. Along the way, they passed busy pixies and goblins, finally reaching Moonface's house at the top. Finding a note on the door encouraging them to join their friends, the children excitedly dreamed of all the wonderful things they would do in the Land of Do As You Please.
